第1章(1)
宪宗元和三年，山南东道节度使于□，为其现年二十有四的儿子－－于季友，入宫求亲。
宪宗深知于氏在襄州一代的实力，只要答应于要求，不费一兵一卒就能收拢这藩镇，立刻允了要求。
而他许配给于季友的，还是他最心爱的掌上明珠，普宁公主。
本以为大事抵定，可没想几天过去，于季友竟然单身进京，说要退婚。
皇宫，御书房里，着粉色绸裙，年仅十六的普宁亭亭跪安。“儿臣普宁见过父王。”
“起来。”皇上唤了声，然后朝立在一旁的男子微笑。“朕帮你介绍，她就是我上回允诺你爹的普宁公主，单名一个苹字。普宁，你身旁这位英武过人的男子，正是当今山南东道节度使于□之子，于季友。”
普宁瞄看生得皮肤黝黑，虎目浓眉的于季友，心底虽纳闷，还是本着礼节招呼。“普宁见过于大人。”
“皇上。”于季友看也没看普宁，一屈身跪下。“微臣心意不变，还望皇上成全。”
怎么回事？！普宁瞧瞧于季友又瞧瞧自个儿父王，一头雾水。
很快地，谜底揭晓。
“为什么？给朕一个理由，我这个女儿也堪称天香国色，贤侄是哪点不中意？”
“不是普宁公主的问题，是微臣，微臣自知高攀不上，不好耽误公主。”
普宁终于听懂了。搞了老半天，原来她父王，把她许配给这家伙；而这家伙知道可以娶她，不谢主隆恩就算了，竟然当着她父王的面拒绝？！
普宁在宫里，谁对她不是百依百顺，哪听得了人家不要她这种事！
皇上望向普宁。“你怎么说？”
普宁不假思索回道：“儿臣愿意。”
于季友虎目怒视，普宁冲着他甜笑－－怎么样，她就是要跟他作对，他不想娶，她就偏要嫁！
“贤侄，这样你没话说了吧！”皇上呵呵笑。
“皇上……”

皇上手一挥。“朕心意已决，你帮朕把话带到，要你爹开始着手准备，婚期，就定在来年三月初一。朕的掌上明珠，今后就由你费心照顾了。”
于季友没漏看普宁那一脸得意。
可恶！于季友心情懊恼，可碍于皇命，又不得不领命照办。
“臣遵旨。”他咬了咬牙，下跪听旨。
就这样，时间飞快过了半年。
山南东道治所位在襄阳，从长安出发，简装轻骑最少也要三天。但考量公主情况，二月十九，准驸马于季友便领十数名带刀护卫，提前来迎娶公主。
隔日清早，一座缀着红缎与珠花的彩轿等在殿前，由丞相段文昌领着百官罗列欢送。八人齐扛的彩轿一出皇宫，百姓夹道伫候，争相目睹这难得一见的盛况。
瞧瞧这望不见底的随行派头－－一对开道锣、一对弯脖号、一对大号、一对伞，一对扇、一对大镜、一对二镜、一对令箭、一对金瓜、一对钺斧、一对朝天镫、两对喇叭、八面大鼓，加上整个队伍七、八十人，还不包括抬嫁奁的队伍与随行的护卫，洋洋洒洒，竟蜿蜒了五、六百里之数。
出了城门，一路只在正午休息了半个时辰，接着又是马不停蹄。原本兴致还算不错的普宁公主－－李苹瞧腻了风景，觉得不耐烦了。
“还要走多久啊？”
随行的女官赶忙来按捺。“公主，此行少也要七、八天时间，您得多忍耐。”
闻言，普宁倏地摘下头上红帕。“传令下去，说公主我累了，我要下轿走走休息。”要她就这样傻坐在轿上八天，她不闷死才怪！
“公主……”女官一脸为难。
普宁一瞪。“你敢不听我的话？”
女官不敢答应，只好匆匆去问于季友。
依礼俗，准新郎倌通常不随行迎娶队伍。但因普宁身份特殊，加上路途遥远、恐生万一，于季友才乔装成护卫，领兵尾随在队伍后边。
高坐白驹上的于季友一听女官来报，浓眉紧蹙。
“回去禀报公主，说婚期将近，路途又远，不能在此驻留。”
女官不敢怠慢，依言回报，却换得普宁一阵娇嗔。
“我说要休息就是要休息，他不答应，教他自个儿走去。”普宁掀帘高喊：“外头人，停轿。”

女官意图阻止。“公主等等……”
外头轿夫一听喊声，当然不敢反抗，齐声一喊“垫轿”，脚步即停了下来。
“不行不行，公主，您现在还不能出来……”
“你以为你在跟谁说话？”
女官吓得跪地道歉。“公主息怒，下官斗胆冒犯，实是因为于礼不合。”
“我管你合不合。”普宁双手插腰。“我坐了半天轿子，腿腰都麻了，下来走走不行吗？”
“公主……”
女官们一筹莫展，这时，铁蹄声由远而近。
普宁回头，只见一身戎装的于季友翻落马背，朝彩轿快步走来。
于季友望着女官们问：“怎么回事？不是说过不准停轿？”
“启禀大人……”
“是我的主意。”普宁转身说话。
说来，这是两人先前在御书房一见后，第二回碰上。
上回顾着斗气，倒忘了细看他长相，只记得他皮肤黝黑，有双炯炯虎目。今回见他一身灰铁戎装，伴着白马，倒显得威风飒飒、气宇非凡。
于季友垂眸注视不到他肩高的普宁，她仍是他记忆中的模样，一张圆脸粉红细致，一双黑眼珠慧黠娇气，配上她一头珠翠与艳红嫁裳，有如宫闱细心照料的紫牡丹，散发不可逼视的雍容贵气。
他抱拳一拜。“请公主立刻回轿，此行时间不多，不能浪费。”
“我偏要在这里休息。”普宁双手抱胸，一脸“你耐我何”的神气。
普宁脾性是出了名的我行我素，这点于季友先前在卸书房见识过；印象极深，也颇不以为然。
他当初胆敢上京退婚，就是知道自个儿脾气，绝对容忍不了皇家公主的娇蛮任性。身带虏族血统的他，一直欣赏能策马奔驰、个性又大方得体的同族女子，偏偏他爹背着他上京求亲。
一个刚正如铁的汉子配上一个矜贵公主，横看竖看就不适合。

“还请公主回轿。”看在普宁身份，于季友忍着脾气再说一次。
“我偏不。”
他沉下脸。“公主执意不听？”
普宁一哼。“你以为你是谁？我干嘛听你的？”
好。他一点头，突然转身走向白马，自鞍里掏出两条皮绳。
一见他表情，普宁神情警戒。“你想做什么？”
“回轿。”他下达最后通牒。
“我不要。”
“那下官只好得罪了。”说完，他一个抢步向前。
普宁还来不及反应，人已被他抓进轿里。
“你做什么你……放开我！”她拚命拍打钳住自个儿腰肢的铁臂。
想不到这家伙不但把她塞进轿里，还用手上皮绳反绑她两只手臂，活当她是匹难驯的野马，皮绳另一头，就系在彩轿围栏上。
“你这家伙，竟敢这样对我！你不要命了你！”她气坏，拚命用脚踢踹。
“公主再撒泼，下官连您的脚一块绑。”
“你敢！”她眼一瞠。
他扬高另一条皮绳，深黝黝的眸里有着不容错辨的决心。
“可恶！”普宁怒叫。她最讨厌有人不听她话，可短短半年内，这样的人就出现了两个，真不晓得自己在走什么霉运，接二连三，老遇上爱跟她作对的臭男人！
于季友望着她说道：“再行三十里，进了镇甸，下官自会过来放人。”
“你以为你这样对我，本公主还会乖乖嫁你？”她抿着小嘴。

Chapter 1(1)
In the third year of Yuanhe reign of Emperor Xianzong, Yu □, the envoy of the Eastern Province of Shannan Province, entered the palace to seek marriage for his twenty-four-year-old son, Yu Jiyou.
Xianzong was well aware of the strength of the Yu family in Xiangzhou. As long as he agreed to the request, he could win over the vassal town without spending a single soldier, so he immediately agreed to the request.
And what he betrothed to Yu Jiyou was his most beloved apple, Princess Puning.
I thought everything was settled, but a few days later, Yu Jiyou came to Beijing alone and said he wanted to break off the engagement.
In the palace, in the royal study, Puning, who is only sixteen years old, is kneeling down in a pink silk skirt. "My son Puning has met my father."
"Get up." The emperor called, and then smiled at the man standing aside. "Let me introduce you to her. She is the Princess Puning whom I promised to be your father last time. Her single name is Ping. Puning, this heroic man next to you is none other than Yu Jiyou, the son of Yu Jiyou, the current governor of the Eastern Province of Shannan."
Puning glanced at Yu Jiyou, who had dark skin, tiger eyes and thick eyebrows. Although he was puzzled in his heart, he still greeted him politely. "Puning has met Mr. Yu."
"Your Majesty." Yu Jiyou knelt down without even looking at Puning. "My heart remains unchanged, and I still hope that the emperor will fulfill my wishes."
What's going on? ! Puning looked at Yu Jiyou and then at his son's father, Wang, confused.
Soon, the mystery was revealed.
"Why? Give me a reason. This daughter of mine can also be called the beauty of heaven. What is it about my nephew that I don't like?"
"It's not Princess Puning's problem, it's Wei Chen's. Wei Chen knows that he can't reach a high level, so he doesn't want to delay the princess."
Puning finally understood. After working on it for a long time, it turned out that her father had betrothed her to this guy; but this guy knew that he could marry her, so he didn't want to thank the Lord for his kindness, but he actually refused in front of her father? !
When Puning is in the palace, whoever is not completely obedient to her would not be able to bear the thought of someone not wanting her!
The emperor looked at Puning. "What did you say?"
Puning replied without hesitation: "My son is willing."
Yu Jiyou glared, Puning smiled sweetly at him - no matter what, she just wanted to go against him, he didn't want to marry, so she insisted on marrying!
"My dear nephew, now you have nothing to say!" The emperor chuckled.
"Your Majesty..."
The emperor waved his hand. "I have made up my mind. You can tell me to tell your father to start preparations. The wedding date will be on the first day of March next year. From now on, you will take care of the apple of my eye."
Yu Jiyou didn't miss Puning's proud face.
hateful! Yu Jiyou was upset, but because of the emperor's order, he had to obey the order.
"I obey the order." He gritted his teeth and knelt down to listen to the order.
In this way, half a year passed quickly.
Shannan Dong Daozhi is located in Xiangyang, and it takes at least three days to set off from Chang'an in plain clothes and light cavalry. However, considering the princess's situation, on February 19th, the prospective prince-in-law Yu Jiyou led a dozen guards with swords to come in advance to marry the princess.
Early the next morning, a colorful sedan decorated with red satin and pearl flowers was waiting in front of the palace, and Prime Minister Duan Wenchang led hundreds of officials to see him off. As soon as the colorful sedan carried by eight people came out of the palace, people lined the streets and waited, vying to witness this rare grand occasion.
Look at the bottomless entourage - a pair of gongs, a pair of trumpets, a pair of tubas, a pair of umbrellas, a pair of fans, a pair of large mirrors, a pair of mirrors, a pair of command arrows, a pair of gourds, a pair of axes, a pair of stirrups, two pairs of trumpets, eight drums, plus a whole team of seven to eighty people, not including the dowry team and the accompanying guards. They were so eloquent that they meandered for five or six hundred miles.
After leaving the city gate, we only rested for half an hour at noon, and then continued non-stop. Princess Puning - Li Ping, who was originally in good spirits, got tired of looking at the scenery and felt impatient.
"How long do we have to go?"
The accompanying female officer rushed to restrain him. "Princess, this trip will take at least seven or eight days, so please be patient."
Hearing this, Puning quickly took off the red handkerchief on his head. "Give me the order, Princess, I'm tired.I want to get off the sedan chair and take a walk to rest. "If you want her to sit on the sedan like this for eight days, I'd be surprised if she doesn't suffocate to death!"
"Princess..." The female officer looked embarrassed.
Puning stared. "You dare not listen to me? "
The female officer did not dare to agree, so she had to ask Yu Jiyou in a hurry.
According to etiquette and custom, the prospective groom usually does not accompany the wedding procession. However, due to Puning's special status, the long journey, and the fear of danger, Yu Jiyou disguised himself as a guard and led the troops to follow the team.
Yu Jiyou, who was sitting high on the white horse, frowned when he heard that the female official had come to report.
"Go back and report to the princess that the wedding is approaching and the journey is far, so you can't stay here. "
The female officer didn't dare to be negligent and repaid her as she was told, but Puning was infuriated for a while.
"I said I wanted to rest, but he didn't agree, so I told him to walk alone. Puning lifted the curtain and shouted: "People outside, stop the sedan." "
The female officer tried to stop him. "Princess, wait..."
When the sedan bearers outside heard the shouting, of course they did not dare to resist. They shouted "cushion the sedan chair" in unison and stopped immediately.
"No, no, princess, you can't come out yet..."
“Who do you think you’re talking to? "
The female officer was so frightened that she knelt down and apologized. "The princess calmed down her anger, but the inferior officer dared to offend her because she was incompatible with etiquette. "
“I don’t care if it’s okay with you. Puning put his hands on his waist. "I've been sitting in the sedan for a long time, and my legs and waist are numb. Can't I come down and take a walk?" "
"Princess..."
The female officials were helpless. At this time, the sound of iron hoofbeats came closer and closer.
Puning turned around and saw Yu Jiyou, dressed in military uniform, getting off his horse and walking quickly towards the colored sedan.
Yu Jiyou looked at the female officials and asked, "What's going on? Didn't you say you are not allowed to stop the sedan? "
"Lord Qi..."
"It was my idea. "Puning turned around and spoke.
Speaking of which, this was the second time the two met after meeting in the Imperial Study Room.
I was looking back at Dou Qi, but I forgot to take a closer look at his appearance. I only remembered that he had dark skin and piercing eyes. This time I saw him dressed in a gray iron military uniform, accompanied by a white horse, and he looked majestic and majestic.
Yu Jiyou lowered his eyes and stared at Puning, who was not as tall as his shoulders. She still looked the same as in his memory, with a round pink face and delicate black eyes, and a pair of smart and delicate black eyes. Paired with her emerald hair and bright red wedding dress, she was like a purple peony carefully cared for by the palace, exuding an unforgettable grace and nobility.
He cupped his fists and bowed. "Princess, please return to the sedan immediately. There is not much time for this trip and cannot be wasted. "
"I want to rest here. "Puning crossed his arms and had an air of "How can you bear with me?"
Puning's temperament is known to go his own way. Ji You had seen this before in the unloading study room; he was deeply impressed but also quite disapproving of it.
He had the guts to go to Beijing to break off the engagement because he knew his temper and would never tolerate the royal princess's coquettishness and willfulness. As a descendant of the Lu tribe, he has always admired women of the same tribe who can ride horses and have generous and decent personalities. However, his father went to Beijing to propose marriage behind his back.
A man who is as strong as iron and a noble princess is not suitable for each other horizontally and vertically.
“Please also ask the princess to return to the sedan chair. "Looking at Puning's status, Yu Jiyou held back his temper and said it again.
"I don't. "
He scowled. "Princess insists on not listening? "
Puning snorted. "Who do you think you are? Why should I listen to you? "
OK. He nodded, suddenly turned around and walked towards the white horse, taking out two leather ropes from the saddle.
Upon seeing his expression, Puning looked alert. "What do you want to do? "
"Go back to the sedan. ” He issued an ultimatum.
"I don't want it. "
"Then the official has no choice but to be offended. "After saying that, he rushed forward.
Before Puning had time to react, he had already caught him and put him in the sedan.
"What are you doing? Let me go! " She desperately slapped the iron arms that clamped her waist.
Unexpectedly, this guy not only stuffed her into the sedan, but also tied her arms with leather ropes behind her back, as if she were an untamable wild horse. The other end of the leather rope was tied to the fence of the sedan.
"You guy, how dare you do this to me! You don't want to kill you! "She was so angry that she tried toMing kicked him with his feet.
"Princess, if you act recklessly again, I will tie your feet together."
"How dare you!" She was stunned.
He raised the other leather rope, his dark eyes filled with unmistakable determination.
"Damn it!" Puning shouted angrily. She hates people who don't listen to her, but in just six months, two such people have appeared. She really doesn't know what kind of bad luck she is running into. One after another, she keeps encountering stinky men who love to go against her!
Yu Jiyou looked at her and said, "We'll go another thirty miles and enter Zhendian. The lower officials will come and let her go."
"Do you think this princess will still marry you if you treat me like this?" She pursed her lips.
